plan.line: an NTC thermistor (10 kΩ, B 3950) that measures temperature from about −20 to 100 °C, accurate to about ±1 °C; a 10 kΩ resistor is added automatically. The code turns its reading into °C. Use it when the idea names a thermistor; for the room's temperature and humidity prefer the DHT11. The bare bead must stay dry. Uses one of the three ADC pins (shared with knobs).

code.pinLine: NTC thermistor {ref} on {gpio}: ADC({g}). It sits on the 3.3 V side of a divider with a 10 kΩ resistor to GND, so read_u16() rises as it gets warmer. To get °C: v = adc.read_u16(); r = 10000 * (65535 - v) / v (the thermistor's ohms; skip v == 0); t = 1 / (1/298.15 + math.log(r / 10000) / 3950) - 273.15 (needs import math). Average a few readings: one ADC reading jumps by about half a degree.
